description: Defines a Java interface 'StatisticsShardConfig' that specifies configuration methods for shard region statistics, including methods to retrieve the region name, role, and supervisor actor path. Contains an embedded enum 'ConfigValues' implementing 'KnownConfigValue' for default config paths and values.

classes.name: StatisticsShardConfig
classes.description: An interface specifying configuration parameters for shard regions, including methods to get region, role, and root actor path.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the cluster role where the shard is started.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the actor path of the supervisor of the shard.
